message.content: {"draft":"Single-pass row mean. Use 2D grid (row, col-chunk) with atomic_add to a fresh FP32 buffer, then a tiny finalize kernel divides by width and casts. Avoids multi-pass loops and per-row block-size limits.","plan":"1) Allocate fp32 buffer (rows,). 2) Launch atomic kernel: each program handles one (row, chunk) of 1024 cols, masked load, sum, atomic_add. 3) Launch finalize kernel: one program per row, load fp32 sum, divide by width, cast to input dtype, store. 4) Return output.","code_lines":["import torch","import triton","import triton.language as tl","","","@triton.jit","def _mean_atomic_kernel(","    X,","    S,","    stride,","    N,","    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):", "    row = tl.program_id(0)","    chunk = tl.program_id(1)","    X += row * stride + chunk * BLOCK_SIZE","    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)","    mask = cols < (N - chunk * BLOCK_SIZE)","    a = tl.load(X + cols, mask=mask, other=0.).to(tl.float32)","    s = tl.sum(a, axis=0)","    tl.atomic_add(S + row, s)","","","@triton.jit","def _finalize_kernel(","    S,","    Y,","    N,","    IS_BF16: tl.constexpr,","):", "    row = tl.program_id(0)","    s = tl.load(S + row)","    mean = s / N","    if IS_BF16:","        mean = mean.to(tl.bfloat16)","    tl.store(Y + row, mean)","","","def run(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:","    assert x.is_cuda","    assert x.dim() == 2","    assert x.is_contiguous()","    rows, width = x.shape","    y = torch.empty((rows,), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)","    s = torch.zeros((rows,), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)","    BLOCK_SIZE = 1024","    n_chunks = triton.cdiv(width, BLOCK_SIZE)","    grid = (rows, n_chunks)","    _mean_atomic_kernel[grid](x, s, width, width, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE, IS_BF16=(x.dtype == torch.bfloat16))","    _finalize_kernel[(rows,)](s, y, width, IS_BF16=(x.dtype == torch.bfloat16))","    return y"]}
